headline: Phalhala or Bust: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Phalhala or Bust is projected #12 of 16 with a 549.80 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Ashton Jeanty, Sam LaPorta, and Rome Odunze. The immediate priority is improving the QB slot without weakening that core.
